title: Copperfield's Great Wall walk-through and Statue of Liberty vanish
place_text: Great Wall of China; Statue of Liberty, New York

tellings.quote: You can you can look at Copfield. You walk through the wall of China. You can make the Statue of Liberty disappear.

plain: In the 1980s the stage magician David Copperfield appeared to walk through the Great Wall of China and to make the Statue of Liberty disappear. A guest named Chris Ramsay brings these feats up with Michels as examples of how convincingly an illusion can fool an audience's eyes.
